title: SPLICE: Sparse Physics Library Identification and Compositional Expansion
abstract: arXiv:2610.17029v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural operator splitting composes a library of neural operators, one per physical mechanism, into zero-shot simulators of new equations. Existing approaches, however, require these mechanisms and their labels to be specified in advance. We ask whether a pretrained library can instead be adapted and grown from unlabeled trajectories in which multiple mechanisms act simultaneously. We introduce SPLICE, a framework that discovers operators without mechanism labels on mixture data. The contributions of the candidate operators to each trajectory are inferred by solving a convex optimization problem. A calibrated test then assigns each discovered operator the mechanism it implements. Failure cases are also detectable, when the library lacks the required physics or when mechanisms are insufficiently separable. translated_title: SPLICE：稀疏物理库识别与组合扩展
translated_abstract: 神经算子拆分方法将一组神经算子（每个物理机制对应一个算子）组合成针对新方程的零样本模拟器。然而，现有方法需要事先指定这些机制及其标签。我们提出的问题是：能否从未标记的、多种机制同时作用的轨迹中调整和扩展一个预训练的算子库？我们引入了SPLICE，这是一个在混合数据上无需机制标签即可发现算子的框架。候选算子对每条轨迹的贡献通过求解凸优化问题来推断。随后，通过一个经过校准的测试为每个发现的算子分配其实现的机制。该框架还能检测失败情况，即当算子库缺乏所需物理机制或各机制之间无法充分分离时。在一维和二维系统上，发现的算子能够从未标记的混合数据中恢复机制，并组合成零样本模拟器。
tldr: SPLICE是一个无需机制标签即可从多机制混合数据中自动发现物理算子的框架，通过凸优化推断贡献、校准测试分配机制，实现算子库的自动扩展并组合成零样本模拟器。
